<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/docker"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Runs docker create, which pulls the image when the host does not have it. Its permission is docker:write, which only the admin role gets: a container that names a command and a bind mount of / runs as root on the host. An agent with agent.command.enabled false refuses a create with a command or a bind mount, as it refuses a command. The environment goes on docker's standard input, not in its arguments, which each user of the host can read. auto_start starts the container once it is made. A container of the name that the host has already is not made again, and reports changed: false.
